overview: A squad of soldiers fight in the Korean War's crucial Battle of Incheon.
tagline: The Odds Were 5000 to 1 … One was all They Needed.

recs.blurb: A noisy and absurd re-telling of the great 1950 invasion of Inchon during the Korean War which was masterminded by General Douglas MacArthur.
